items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Reeg was running this date, and so big, fat Teddy Reeg -- you might see him going around with Basie a lot

ctx.x: Yeah, yes, anyway, we -- it was either real late at night or early in the morning, and we all had black coffee, about ten cups of black coffee. So in these days these benzedrine inhalers were very popular. So Charlie Parker, he didn't have any stuff this time, so he broke open a benzedrine inhaler, and this thing was equivalent to 75 benzedrine tablets, and he put it in the coffee to let it soak, you know.

And so finally Rubberlegs was already half drunk, had some bad liquor, man. He didn't drink nothing but cheap liquor. So he got to hulling, and it got hot because he -- and he wanted some coffee. So Teddy Reeg was running this date, and so big, fat Teddy Reeg -- you might see him going around with Basie a lot -- so he grabbed the coffee up, and he drank it, you know, and then he really got wild after that.
